contexts.text: (A Jewish Rabbin from the filthy Jerusalem.) SE 1195. SE 1196.
The shepherds could receive the Lord when born; but not the Rabbins.

By Rabbi, and Teacher () is signified one who teaches truth; thus, abstractedly, the doctrine of truth; and, in the supreme sense, the Divine Truth, which is Christ. That He alone is the Divine truth, is meant by, Be not ye called Rabbi; one is your Teacher, Christ. AE 746:13.
